## Owner and linkage

- Accountable owner: @sergio-tr
- Linear: SER-...
- GitHub Issue: #...
- Decision IDs: D-..., AUD-..., ADR-...
- Branch: feature/*, bugfix/*, docs/* or other approved independent branch

## Source, purpose and boundaries

State the original source, exact change, alternatives, invariants, bounded context ownership, unratified dependencies and what remains explicitly out of scope.

## Validation and review

- [ ] All text is in English.
- [ ] Commit messages use type(scope): subject.
- [ ] No co-author or external tool contributor credits.
- [ ] No secrets, customer personal data or exposed digital licenses.
- [ ] No implicit acceptance of historical proposals or PENDING technical decisions.
- [ ] No P0 closure without independently accepted proof and contracts.
- [ ] No TEST_PLANNED result is represented as VERIFIED.
- [ ] User authorization covers the precise change scope.

## Traceability

Requirement → Audit → ADR → Specification → Linear → GitHub → PR → Contract → Test → Evidence.

## Approval

@sergio-tr is the accountable reviewer. Merging a PR cannot, by itself, ratify an undecided business or technical policy.
